H01C.fTerm:
RESISTORS

Note(s)

  • In this subclass, the following term is used with the meaning indicated:[2]
    • "adjustable" means mechanically adjustable.
  • Variable resistors, the value of which is changed non-mechanically, e.g. by voltage or temperature, are classified in group H01C 7/00.
